build.beforeDevCommand: cd client && npm install && npm run set-backend-url -- https://CHANGEME && npm run watch
build.beforeBuildCommand: cd client && npm install && npm run set-backend-url -- https://CHANGEME && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob:; frame-src blob:; connect-src 'self' https://CHANGEME; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
